findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因素：中國賣家占第三方賣家服務與廣告營收相當比重，中國供應商提供相當比重的零組件與成品，關稅政策變動與貿易爭端可能不利營運結果
findings.excerpt: because China-based sellers account for significant portions of our third-party seller services and advertising revenues, and China-based suppliers provide significant portions of our components and finished goods, regulatory and trade restrictions, tariff policy changes and trade disputes, data protection and cybersecurity laws, economic factors, geopolitical events, security issues, or other factors negatively impacting China-based sellers and suppliers could adversely affect our operating results.

findings.claim: 10-K MD&A：全球關稅與貿易政策不可預測的變動對營運結果有難以預測與量化的影響，預期影響延續至2026Q1
findings.excerpt: global economic and geopolitical developments, including unpredictable shifts in global tariff and trade policies, and the development and adoption of technologies and services, including artificial intelligence, have direct and indirect impacts on our results of operations that are difficult to predict, isolate, and quantify.

note: 搜尋結果多為賣家部落格且關稅現況互相矛盾（IEEPA 關稅是否被最高法院推翻未證實），未採用；出口管制/實體清單未另搜。
